attempts.summary: Implemented, via an Ansible playbook run from the control node (node4), a router topology where node1 bridges two private networks (lan-a to node2, lan-b to node3). node2's egress toward node3 is capped at 1 Mbit/s with a tc tbf qdisc applied automatically on interface bring-up; node3's egress toward node2 is left unrestricted. All four nodes were individually restarted and verified to recover with persisted configuration.
